Only 40% winners and still profitable? ⚖️
10 trades: 4 wins at +3R, 6 losses at −1R = +6R (+12% at 2% risk per R). The same 40% win rate at 1:1 risk:reward loses −2R.
Risk:reward beats win rate. Win less, win bigger.
